title: EVERYDAYMMQA: A MULTILINGUAL AND MULTIMODAL FRAMEWORK FOR CULTURALLY GROUNDED SPOKEN VISUAL QA

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking multimodal models on the OASIS dataset, which consists of culturally specific, everyday visual QA pairs spanning 18 Arab countries, to evaluate their culturally grounded reasoning and robustness against Western-centric biases.

Measuring and comparing model accuracy and generation quality (using BERTScore and LLM-as-judge) across English, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and underrepresented regional dialects (Egyptian and Levantine) to assess cross-lingual and dialectal performance disparities.
